cards.name: Etihad Guest Visa Gold Card
cards.notes: Earn per PDF: Gold 1 mile per 4, Platinum 2.2 per 4, Infinite 2.5 per 4 local (3.5 per 4 on Etihad Airways), higher internationally (Gold 1.5, Plat 3, Inf 3.5 per 4). The PDF does not name the spend unit for "per 4"; assumed AED 4 (so base_rate = miles/4 per AED) - unverified, which is why confidence stays medium. Mile value 0.03 AED is our conservative guess. Fee is the PDF figure times 1.05.
